body: Fetch the canonical publisher script without merging the dirty control checkout, execute it, and verify the live Doré Design workspace exposes the Watchtower Fold page.

argv: import urllib.request,json; w=json.loads(urllib.request.urlopen('http://127.0.0.1:4310/api/workspace',timeout=5).read().decode()); p=next((x for x in w.get('pages',[]) if x.get('id')=='new-westside-watchtower-fold'),None); assert p is not None; assert len(p.get('nodes',[]))==17; print(json.dumps({'ok':True,'code':'WATCHTOWER_EDITOR_LIVE_API_VISIBLE','page_id':p['id'],'page_name':p['name'],'revision':w.get('revision')},ensure_ascii=False))
